description:
Read one autotune job started by ``start_autotune_job``.

``status`` is ``running``, ``complete``, or ``failed``. On ``complete``,
``result`` holds the Pareto-best weights, overshoot, settling time, RMSE,
and solve time. ``pareto_profiles`` names up to three points already evaluated
(tight tracking, balanced, smooth) and ``pareto_points`` is the plot cloud.
The top-level ``Q``, ``R``, ``Rd``, and ``Qf`` stay the study winner.
Poll again while it is ``running``. When payment enforcement
is on, pass the ``job_token`` from the start call or the ``X-Job-Token``
header. A failed job reports ``autotune_failed``.

job_token.description: Token returned with the job when payment enforcement is on. Omit it when the X-Job-Token header carries the same token. This poll is free and does not spend a credit.

name: get_autotune_job
title: Read an autotune job
